summary: Bendy entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Bendy and the Ink Machine
entries.definitive_edition: Complete PC release with all chapters installed

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC complete build with chapter/collectible state documented

primary.why: The complete PC route includes all five chapters and is the best capture baseline. Console, mobile, and current-gen ports are useful access routes, while Bendy and the Dark Revival is a separate sequel.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release with all chapters installed. Record build, chapter, difficulty, audio logs/collectibles, graphics settings, input, subtitles/language, and whether console/mobile/current-gen ports were compared.

secondary.why: PC remains the clean capture route.

all_releases.platform: Windows PC / macOS / Linux episodic release
PlayStation / Xbox / Nintendo Switch / iOS / Android

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Episodic, complete, and port routes have different build/content states.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Bendy and the Dark Revival or Boris and the Dark Survival.
